meta_description: Glenn’s Muffler & Fabrication serving Seneca - auto repair that shows up when you call.
h1_emph: A higher standard of auto repair in Seneca.
hero_lede: Auto repair done right. Call and we will take a look.
about_p1: We handle auto repair for drivers who need it done right.
about_p2: Every photograph on this site is our own work, and it covers brakes, steering and suspension, exhaust and underbody. We work out of Seneca and the towns around it.
area_h2: Where we take on auto repair work near Seneca
svc_hero_h1: The auto repair work we take on
svc_list_h2: The auto repair work we do

reviews.author: Jake Grant
reviews.text: Great folks to deal with. He welded my enclosed trailer wall and helped me get my rotorooter machine back going before my next job. His Dad was a great man and I know he would be proud of the shop his son is running. Thanks for helping us at Grants Drain Care. We will be doing business in the future if the needs arrive. Again, thank you!

reviews.author: Samantha Sane
reviews.text: Great shop! Took my wrangler to be checked out. Very nice mechanics. Parker and Jeff knew exactly what they were talking about. This is the place to get you are looking for.

reviews.author: Amanda “Mandi” Mulvey
reviews.text: Scheduled me quickly, quick repair, my car runs better, very friendly, great price... Absolutely no complaints!!

reviews.author: Ethan Buffkin
reviews.text: These guys are awesome. They've worked on my exhaust a few times now and I'm more than happy with them. They installed a dual exhaust on my truck, replaced a muffler later on, and just put 2 new ones on and it has been good, fast work everytime. Couldn't recommend anyone else, these guys are great. Down to Earth people who aren't trying to make a killing off of you.

reviews.author: Stephanie Gonzalez
reviews.text: These guys are God sent! Helped fixed my exhaust leak and are super friendly and very quick. Been there multiple times last minute and they always are so kind and their prices are very reasonable compared to the other places around! Great quality work and genuinely great people overall!! Would recommend to anyone looking for an honest and quick mechanic! Keep up the amazing work!

reviews.author: Thomas Hutchins
reviews.text: If I could give more than 5 stars I would. 10/10 experience. Excellent price! Just $40 for installation of a new catalytic converter, front flex exhaust pipe, and new O2 sensor.

reviews.author: Nicholas Cain
reviews.text: only doing 1 star because ive tried every possible way to make an appointment and finally went inside to make one and on the day of the appointment i get there and shop is closed with no warning no phone call nothing. beyond pissed why its so hard to get a simple appointment

reviews.author: Joleen Oh
reviews.text: Luckily this shop is local to the county I live in. He really helped me out by fixing my car. This shop has helped My husband for many years before. Grateful for them to be able to get my car moving again with out too much problems

reviews.author: Layne Ellis
reviews.text: Fast and friendly service, more than reasonable pricing. Does everything they can to work you into their schedule based off your availability. More than please to support.

reviews.author: Vernon Miller
reviews.text: These guys are great! They do superb work and are fair and work quickly. It’s crazy that those 3 things are in the same sentence! They’ve done 3 exhaust systems for me and always do great! Best around for sure!

reviews.author: Patsy Lowery
reviews.text: I called on a Friday afternoon with a concern that my tailpipe on my car was about to fall off. They told me to come right over & they would check it out. Within 20 minutes I was fixed & on my way! So friendly & accomodating at a reasonable price.

reviews.author: Billy Blohm
reviews.text: Muffler dropped while traveling for work. Within the hour, Tommy and team built new pipe, and had us back on the road. Great friendly service!

reviews.author: Ethan Partain
reviews.text: Went in for some exhaust work and from the moment I stepped in the door I felt relaxed, the customer service is immaculate. I drove about 45 minutes. The price was perfect and were very quick and efficient with quality work. Would give 20 stars if I could

reviews.author: jeff cyman
reviews.text: Definitely my hometown go to when it's anything exhaust related. 3 years countless vehicles and zero disappointments! These guys never let me down.

reviews.author: Will Ashley
reviews.text: Great shop. Initially had a muffler delete done ($45) on my 128i, but the tips that I ordered were too large for my bumper. Took it back after I received my new tips, and they welded them on for $20. Excellent quality and customer service. However, making an appointment is a must. The first time I visited the shop they were quite slow due to quarantine, so Tommy as well as the other shop hand had me in and out in 30 min with no appointment.. After the quarantine was lifted, I had to book an appointment a week out. Nothing wrong with that, as they do great work for fair prices. Would highly recommend if you are looking for quality work at an affordable price.

reviews.author: Marisa
reviews.text: Very fairly priced and transparent! They were quick to fix my car even though they were very busy. I don’t know how often I’ll need muffler work done but I know I’ll be going here whenever I do!

reviews.author: Norm M
reviews.text: What a great place! I needed some work done on my old Tacoma. I stopped here because I was in Seneca on other business and wasn’t in the truck needing repair. I did have a picture on my phone of the rusted flange that needed replacement that I showed to the friendly employee that came out of the garage to meet me. He analyzed the picture and said they could quickly and easily take care of the problem. He invited me to make an appointment and they had time the same afternoon. I arrived early and they quickly got my truck up on their lift. They invited me to look over the exhaust system which needed more than a flange replacement. Mr. Glenn offered a very reasonable estimate for the work and said they could take care of it right away. They replaced my exhaust system in about an hour. The work was done carefully and with quality workmanship. Mr. Glenn and his employee know their trade and do what they say they will do. There are many auto repair businesses including most dealerships that could learn from Mr. Glenn about how to run a good business that is customer focused, efficient and interested in delivering the best product for a fair price.

reviews.author: Tim Tommy
reviews.text: This place has been the same from day one I am 50 years old and this place has not changed one bit. With that being said this is a good thing. And then they have a lady that also gets her hands dirty. So to me that tells me that they do not discriminate against ladies or men. So it should make you feel comfortable at taking your vehicle here to have it worked on. Before I left I climbed up under my ranger and was really surprised on the job that they done they went Way beyond what they promised and done more. I feel like a brand new exhaust system, oh wait a minute it is a brand new one. Thank you Glenn's muffler y'all really done an outstanding job you cannot ask for a better job you went way and beyond. And you followed the directions I gave. You think of the customers first so therefore that's the reason this review is being bragged upon thank you all once again

reviews.author: Scott Blackwell Sr
reviews.text: Took my Honda Accord in yesterday for exhaust repair as always a great job!! Tommy sure would be proud of his son and his group of guys he has they were such great guys and very polite and respectful, Tommy Glenn's legacy lives on!!

reviews.author: Rick Miller
reviews.text: I highly recommend Glenn's Muffler. They did a fantastic job! Everyone was very courteous and professional. They just seem like a group of very good people.

reviews.author: Kristel Stephens
reviews.text: Totally awesome experience. These guys are fantastic!!! They fixed up my muffler, explained everything, did it quickly, and at an amazing price. This shop is the best!!!! Thank you.

reviews.author: Sarah Rodgers
reviews.text: The staff was friendly, the service was speedy, and the price was great. I could not recommend Glenn's Muffler Shop more! My car was so loud before, and my muffler was completely rusted through. I brought my car in and the entire appointment took less than 45 minutes, and now my car is so quiet! Thank you!!

reviews.author: Bob H
reviews.text: Can’t say enough about the great service I received on my Explorer exhaust system. Liked them so much I had them install a new exhaust system on my 67 Mustang.

reviews.author: Dale spiess
reviews.text: I took my 1966 Pontiac into Glenn’s for new mufflers. On the way the battery literally exploded. Not only did they do an excellent job installing the mufflers but they went to the parts store, purchased a battery and installed it all at a very fair cost. They were very helpful and understanding through the whole process. I highly recommend Glenn’s!!

reviews.author: Bob Cratchet
reviews.text: Had a great experience here. Glenn's muffler was highly recommended to me by a friend. I took my LS swap project there to get a header back exhaust done and they did a fantastic job. Everyone on staff was very professional, the quality of the work was top notch, and the price was very very good. The exhaust must have been a little tough to route as the clearance between headers and steering shaft/starter was less than an inch, but Tommy made it seem easy. Even got the 02 sensors in there like it was nothing. Big thanks to Glenn's muffler for helping me get this machine on the road, i'll definitely be back next time i need something done.

reviews.author: David Singleton
reviews.text: I called and talked to Parker about my 2004 Ford Ranger 3.0 exhaust, wanted a nice sound but not loud he recomended the magnaflow muffler with the duals that I wanted. He and his crew did great work. I got the sound I wanted and great customer service on top of it. Resonably priced and great work! If you want a good and honest shop, call and talk to Parker.

reviews.author: Lee Anne Hagan
reviews.text: Had a great experience at Glenn's Muffler shop. Worked me in within 24 hrs of calling, got to me ontime, awesome service, made me feel welcome and very reasonibly priced. I expected it to cost more. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Paul Zaagman
reviews.text: These guys just flat out get it done. Answered the phone before they were open. Fit me in same day. Have such a humble and grateful attitude. Nailed it. Can’t boast enough raving fan!!! And ps you don’t typically review unless it’s awesome or horrible… this one is awesome 10- stars

reviews.author: Daniel Bender
reviews.text: I am from out of state and while visiting family for the holidays had a fairly simple issue with my muffler and the heat shield above the muffler. Glenn’s muffler shop got my car in very quick and had it fixed in no time. Overall, the gentlemen working were very nice and knew what the issue with my car was. I highly recommend this muffler shop for all your muffler needs!

reviews.author: Madison M
reviews.text: Mr. Tommy and Michael are great guys and great workers! They were able to get me all set up even without a appointment! And wow, such beautiful welds! I'll for sure be back for my next project!

reviews.author: Albert Payne
reviews.text: Those guys are awesome, they took my truck right in and put duals on it and was quick doing it and at a very nice price. I would recommend these guys 100 percent.

reviews.author: Barry Bowen
reviews.text: Unbelievable service. Fast convenient and a really great price. I’m disabled and everything was so convenient. I didn’t even get comfortable before it was completed and I left feeling I had the best of them on price. I would definitely recommend them to take care of your exhaust needs.

reviews.author: Kristopher Cleveland
reviews.text: Quick and easy service. I went in thinking I was going to have to buy a new muffler, but instead was able to get my current one welded back on instead. Walked out with spending significantly less, and didn't even have to wait 30 mins.

reviews.author: Kimberly Allen
reviews.text: I was early for my appt, I was greeted at the door and welcomed like I was family, nice place to sit while you wait for your estimate, they didn't charge anything to look at my muffler and their prices are very reasonable. Hardly no wait... Very friendly and professional... Will be back if I ever need this kind of work again.. Thank you for a wonderful experience!!!

reviews.author: Vanessa Peyton
reviews.text: Glenn has done the exhaust on my durango and on my fiancé suburban. He does an awesome job and he takes the time to talk to you about exactly what you want. You can tell everyone that works there wants to make sure you are satisfied with what you are getting done. I highly recommend him!

reviews.author: Makeda Wearen
reviews.text: Maaan I'm new here an all I can say is if you need ya car fixed this is the spot I promise you these young men are amazing. I be wanting to give them all hugs but don't want to over step my boundaries.They Def send you on ya way with a giant smile an they don't take up no time . 10 stars up if I could.

reviews.author: Joel
reviews.text: Just recently we to Glenn's to get my muffler checked out. With in 20 minutes, at most, my car was already fixed and off the lift! It sounds great now and I highly recommend them if you are a student at Clemson. They are reasonable and they are fast, what could be better?!

reviews.author: Roy Johnson
reviews.text: We were from out of town - they were perfect with both the appt. time and time to complete the job - The job was done above workmanship standards with a cost well below my cost estimate! Excellent group!

reviews.author: Robert Sundeen
reviews.text: Was trying to do an exhaust replacement by myself, but could not get the spring bolts to the exhaust manifold to break free. These guys got me in the next day, put the car on the lift and had the bolts free in less than 10 minutes. The charge? Nothing! Zip! Nada! Not guaranteeing your repair will end that way, but I will return whenever I need this kind of work and refer them to anyone I meet! 92 reviews and all 5 star?? I believe it!

reviews.author: Justin Tanner
reviews.text: Called Glenn's and they told me to stop by. Within 15 minutes of getting there, he already had my Rover on the lift and was putting a weld on it. Great place and will recommend to anyone needing muffler work.

reviews.author: Caroline Culbertson
reviews.text: Tommy is truly skilled and quick! Very cost effective and knowledgeable. He gave all options and the cost of each. He worked hard but was still very personable! Only place ill ever return to for any future needs!

reviews.author: Gary Auerbach
reviews.text: When you’re on vacation out of state and your car starts to sound like a revved up motorcycle it’s a little scary to take it in to a shop. But not if you find Glenn’s!! Super clean garage and Tommy fixed my muffler in 20 minutes and for 1/5th what I expected to pay. Thanks for making the rest of our trip quieter!

reviews.author: Michelle Pointer
reviews.text: So we took Chelsey’s car to Glenn’s Muffler Shop and they put in a new Flex Pipe. Today we took it back due to the loud rattling noise. They looked at it and called us back to come pick it up. Stating that the noise has nothing to do with the muffler, it is in the engine. They think it is the EGR Valve or Catalytic Converter. We bring it home and all my husband did was hold the muffler with his foot as seen in the video. We called them back and explained what Gary just did, and they ( Parker) literally argued with him and were extremely rude and condescending. Saying he doesn’t know what he’s talking about because they put it up on the lift and examined it. So glad we didn’t take Old Blue here, as we intended. I posted video on Facebook showing my husband putting his foot on the tailpipe and the rattle stopping, as proof. Everyone makes mistakes, but to blatantly be rude af, is why the post. The guy told us to take it to Anderson muffler shop, because they wouldn’t fix it I would definitely not use them again, nor recommend them!

reviews.author: Robert Bryant
reviews.text: They charge an honest and fair price they are really efficient and get you out in a timely manner. I originally got a quote from Meineke which was over $300. They charged me a fraction of that cost and with better customer service. I highly recommend them

reviews.author: Mathieu El Sokhn
reviews.text: Put a cat-back exhaust on my car but the drone was too annoying. Came in to these guys on a Friday afternoon and they took care of me immediately by welding a J-pipe to the system which eliminated the drone! Great, honest, fast and reliable service, highly recommended.

reviews.author: carroll christopher
reviews.text: Called the shop to get muffler delete on my 2010 Mustang GT. Both mufflers off, new pipes and the original tips welded back on in under an hour. The man is fast and a great eye for quality. My Mustang sounds amazing thanks to Glenn's Muffler Shop. P. S. And I got a free flash light /ink pen as a gift for Christmas...! Win, win.

reviews.author: Oleksandr Klep
reviews.text: Very fast and professional service at a very reasonable price, I would even say cheap price. This is my experience with this shop: previous owner of my Jeep decided that it is a great idea to install smaller than stock catback system on a Hemi engine making it loud as hell and I needed exhaust that can handle mild upgrades to the engine so small catback that was installed had to go. Within a minute (60 seconds, probably even less) after stepping into the office I was able to explain what I had and what I wanted to be done with my Jeep. Two minutes later I already had an estimate for the replacement of the entire catback system that would match my needs and this two minutes include the time that was needed to inspect my current exhaust. As promised just after lunch I received a call inviting me back to pick up my Jeep. Now I have exhaust that is big enough to accommodate future upgrades and is looking and sounding just like I wanted. And the important part is the price of my upgrade was surprisingly low. All welds look professional and there are no leaks in my new exhaust. Great work. Thank you. Highly recommended for any exhaust work.

reviews.author: E Scott Rush
reviews.text: They took my catalytic converter and now I have a check engine light on and my vehicle smells like gas on the inside. I’m couldn’t believe they did this when the part I needed fixed was under the hood, but apparently, I unknowingly agreed to it when I signed the receipt. In fine print the receipt said that I was agreeing to donate my catalytic converter to keep my bill low. In my opinion, this is bad business practice and should not be allowed. In any other state I wouldn’t be able to pass the smog test, but I guess that’s why they know they can get away with it in SC.

reviews.author: The Critique
reviews.text: Same day fix, not a long wait. Astounding customer service! Love it! I would recommend anyone to go here. Y'all are awesome! #fordfiestachic

reviews.author: brian Nailor
reviews.text: Tommy Glenn is exceptionally skilled and equally personable! Truly inspired by the work and what a great person Tommy is!!! I literally love paying him as he exemplifies what owning a company should be about...providing outstanding service!

reviews.author: Ernest Mayberry
reviews.text: My '04 Infiniti G35 had holes in the pipes after the catalytic converter and a rusty flange connection at the muffler. Went to a general auto repair shop who quoted $900 for a complete system from catalytic converter to car tail. When I balked at the high price, they said they really didn't do much exhaust system work so only could offer a replacement system. However, they were good enough to recommend Glenn's. After a 10 minute system check at Glenn's, I made an appointment for the next day with a $100 estimate and no more than 1-1/2 hours. He did the job in 45 minutes at 1/10 the price of the complete system. Car sounds like new. If you are in the Seneca vicinity, do yourself a favor and go to Glenn's first for your exhaust system issues.

reviews.author: ROBERT HUNSBERGER
reviews.text: Very straight forward up front details as to different steps to go they fixed us up for $20.00 as where dealership tried taking me for a fool and wanted $1200.00 to replace what they said couldn’t be fixed definitely will refer and be our new exhaust shop from now on thanks to the crew and office personnel very respectful and polite

reviews.author: Matt Young
reviews.text: Love this place, I remember coming to him when I got my license. Just went back today from not having a truck worthy of exhaust and it was just like I remember. Tommy definitely knows what to do to give you the sound you want

reviews.author: Hunter Pope
reviews.text: I took my 2004 ford mustang gt just expecting to talk about changing up the exaust i left with my car sounding exactly how I wanted it in under an hour. The staff were all extremely nice I would definitely recommend Glenn's muffler shop

reviews.author: Happy Tiger
reviews.text: Tommy (as his dad before him) sees to your needs. If you don't check this place out, you will have PAID MORE AND GOT LESS!! As a plus, they always have a " project" going on over in a corner that's fun to marvel at. Since Tommy is also in the fabrication business, if he doesn't have it, He Makes It.. quite a good thing when you have a special need..

reviews.author: King Sanguinary
reviews.text: My catalytic converters were stolen. Had them weld me up again and did a great job! Staff was friendly and knowledgeable. Will be using them in the future from now on.

reviews.author: BIG SIX
reviews.text: The only person I go to to have egsaust work done. Clean nice beaded welds and alot cheaper and higher quality than anywhere else. I've also heard if you know how to talk to him you may even be able to sucker him into making egsaust headders. But it's rare seen a set on a hotrod he made. Great quality

reviews.author: Brad Connally
reviews.text: Very friendly service, made the appointment and I was in and out in 30 minutes. Great quality work and very fair price. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Eric Wakefield
reviews.text: Excellent! I needed a couple welds put on a tractor shift lever and I was out in 15 minutes and paid close to nothing. Outstanding work, great service, great people, and I will be coming back.

reviews.author: The Least
reviews.text: BEWARE!!!! READ THE FINE PRINT... YOU'RE AGREEING TO RELINQUISH YOUR CATALYTIC CONVERTER AS A: "CCORE CHARGE" WHEN I TRIED TO SELL MY Chrysler van I FOUND OUT THE CAT THE TOOK FROM ME was worth a couple of thousand. It was a Chrysler DOUBLE-CAT-EXAUST! It's not a fair way of doing business, especially against a family living at poverty level! THEY REPLACED MY CATS WITH SIMILAR SHAPED MUFFLERS...when they could have welded a straight pipe same effect. My guess is they do that to fool the customers eyes.

reviews.author: Chris M
reviews.text: Awesome place! Has been family owned forever. Best custom muffler work you will find and can also fix anything dealing with metal.

reviews.author: Brett Frye
reviews.text: Stellar service at Glenn's shop. I was in and out in 30 minutes. So happy with my visit and highly recommend! Also, Marley (the shop dog) is the sweetest thing.

reviews.author: Anon
reviews.text: Went for issue diagnosed by another shop. Because I questioned the initial diagnosis, they referred me to another shop to double check the problem, and I'm so thankful they did. Saved from unnecessary repair. Will definitely go again! Friendly and honest people!!!

reviews.author: Lee Noroña
reviews.text: This place is great! Fast, great price. I live in Charleston. I will drive up here if I ever need more muffler work done.

reviews.author: Kenneth Cox
reviews.text: Didn't have an appt but stopped in to see if they had time to do a small repair on my sons truck and they took us right in, repaired the problem and off we were. Locally owned and very professional!!

reviews.author: Lee Tilson
reviews.text: Excellent service! Not only with exhaust but I also needed tubing a while back and he helped me get what I needed for a buggy build I'm doing!

reviews.author: Cole Dills
reviews.text: Guys did an amazing job on my custom exhaust for my Chevy Silverado. Did everything I asked with amazing quality!!!!!

reviews.author: Sabrina Brinkman
reviews.text: Great fantastic service by Mr Glenn and his guys. Very reasonable prices!!! New to the area and found him online through his reviews.

reviews.author: Wiley Parker
reviews.text: Great business with expert and friendly service. I've never had a problem with any of their work and have used them for over thirty years.

reviews.author: Brandon Day
reviews.text: Really nice people. He does great work. Will definitely come here to get my exhaust work done on all my cars.

reviews.author: That Carolina Interceptor
reviews.text: Only place I go for custom exhaust work and repairs. Does great work for reasonable price. Doesn't overcharge and his welds are clean and strong.

reviews.author: Chad Alderman
reviews.text: Have known this family for years great people! I've used at least 4 or 5 times quality work done quick!

reviews.author: Andrew Miller
reviews.text: Very respectful workers, they know what they are doing and did the job very good on my car. Highly recommend this place

reviews.author: Jess Adams
reviews.text: They did a good job and fast. They didn't overcharge like a lot of other places , best shop I've been to in a long time

reviews.author: Woody Poole
reviews.text: I have done business with Glenn's for over 20 years. They are always friendly, professional, and do excellent work.

reviews.author: Ernie Wike
reviews.text: Best exhaust place I've ever been to. Insanely good and very reasonable prices. I wouldn't go anywhere else.

reviews.author: Koby Burns
reviews.text: If you need any work done on your muffler this is the place to go, great people and great work, highly recommended!

reviews.author: Matt Allen
reviews.text: I can't emphasize enough how much I like this place. Kind and friendly staff, quick turnaround, and they know what they are doing.

reviews.author: Rick Blassingame
reviews.text: Excellent place I've always been a satisfied customer just visited there today satisfied again as usual!
